test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: India's first graphene innovation center will be set up in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is a **joint venture** of the **Digital University of Kerala, the Centre for Materials for Electronics Technology (C-MET)** and **Tata Steel Limited.** It will be set up in **Thrissur Kerala.**
 
• Graphene is a **one-atom-thick layer of carbon atoms** arranged in a **hexagonal arrangement**.
 
• An **Innovation Center** is a **cross-functional plan** that creates **a safe haven for new ideas.**
 
• Earlier in 2020, researchers from the **City University of Hong Kong** produced **a laser-induced form of graphene masks** that **inactivate** the **coronavirus species.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **state** government would provide the **basic infrastructure** for the project. The **Centre **would help** attract investors** to develop graphene products.
 
• The project would give a **major boost** to **scientific research** as well as the state’s **industrial sector.**
 
• This result in Kerala’s **human resources** capital being effectively exploited, which will help Kerala to emerge as a **knowledge-based economy.**
